# Temple Scroll Column 29 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 29 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**29:1** You shall consecrate them and they shall be holy. You shall sanctify the altar, and it shall be most holy.

**29:2** You shall consecrate the laver and its base and sanctify them; they shall be most holy.

**29:3** You shall consecrate the entire inner court — the altar, the house, the laver, the colonnade, and all the vessels of service — and they shall be most holy in perpetuity.

**29:4** You shall consecrate the middle court, with its colonnades, its chambers, and its gates; it shall be holy.

**29:5** You shall consecrate them, and they shall be for Me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation, as I declared to Moses on the day I brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

**29:6** The holy of holies, the holy place, the place of the altar, and the courts — these constitute the dwelling-place of My name.

**29:7** For in it I will cause My glory to reside, until the day of blessing when I Myself shall create My temple and establish it for Myself for all time.

**29:8** In accordance with the covenant I established with Jacob at Bethel, and the promise I made to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

**29:9** I will sanctify the land to be like the Garden of Eden, and the earth before it to shine like the sun and the moon; for I will dwell in its midst.

**29:10** My glory shall rest upon it, and I will not thrust them away from before My face. They shall know that I am the LORD their God.

**29:11** They shall be My people and I shall be their God. The king of My people shall serve before Me throughout all his days.

**29:12** A kingdom of priesthood — a holy nation — they shall be before Me in the land that I give to them.

**29:13** The land shall be holy, from the wilderness of Egypt to the wilderness, and from the shore of the Great Sea to the Euphrates.

**29:14** The land and all that is in it shall be holy to Me — all its fruit and all its produce. The tithes and the firstfruits shall belong to the house of My sanctuary.

**29:15** The entire earth shall acknowledge that I am the God of Israel, and the father of all the children of Jacob.

**29:16** I shall reign over them forever, from this generation to the age everlasting, for I am the LORD their God.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 29 well preserved. The eschatological heart of the Temple Scroll. The "day of blessing" (v.7) introduces the concept of a future, divinely constructed temple that supersedes the human-built structure described in the surrounding columns. The Bethel covenant (Gen 28:10-22) and Edenic restoration (v.9) place the temple within a cosmic-historical framework. The covenant formula "My people... their God" (v.11) echoes Jeremiah 31:33.*
